Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position

In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg, Aarhus or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS

• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443

• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations

• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities

• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration

• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position

• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders

• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

**Service Desk Technician - Network

**Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.

**What You Need To Succeed

**

• Relevant education in IT/ networking.

• Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.

**About The Role And The Team

**You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.

The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.

The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift****s, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.

The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.

**What You’ll Be Working On

**

• Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems.

• Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality.

• Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products.

• Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs.

• Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments.

• Contribute to quality assurance of customer solutions and participate in customer meetings when needed.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and take responsibility for moving your cases forward. You can maintain an overview when priorities change or a customer situation becomes critical, and you communicate technical information clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge.

Experience from telecommunications or IT would be useful, as would knowledge of SD-WAN, Layer 2 and Layer 3. Experience with Cisco, Juniper or similar network equipment, ServiceNow, ITIL or network certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA or ACMA would also be an advantage.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

**Our recruitment process

**

• Talent Acquisition Screening Interview

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• References

• Final alignment meeting

**Practical information

**

• Location: Copenhagen.

• The role is primarily office-based.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

You will get the opportunity to work with B2B network and security services, take ownership of operational customer cases and collaborate closely with colleagues in a specialised team.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

**About Us

**GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

• Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down

• Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat

• Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI

• Build AI into core product features

• Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

• Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS

• Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

• Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

• Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.

• Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.

• You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.

• Comfortable talking to customers.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Work independently.

• Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

• Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies

• Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company

• Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office

• Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

Building scalable manufacturing operations requires more than improving individual processes. It requires production systems designed for flow, teams capable of sustaining change, and a continuous improvement culture that turns operational challenges into measurable business results.

As our Operational Excellence Manager, you will play a key role in NOVENCO’s future manufacturing strategy. You will lead a small team of Production Technicians and Engineers, develop and optimise production systems, introduce new production lines, and drive Lean and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.

**Your Impact

**

• Design and implement new production lines and manufacturing layouts, improving flow, efficiency, safety, quality and scalability while supporting NOVENCO’s future production requirements.

• Lead Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement initiatives using Lean methodologies including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, root cause analysis and standardisation to reduce waste and improve operational performance.

• Drive cross-functional improvement and transformation projects, working across Production, Engineering, Quality and other functions to improve productivity, lead time and manufacturing effectiveness.

• Lead and develop a small team of Production Technicians and Engineers, building a highly engaged and high-performing team capable of delivering operational improvements and supporting production development.

• Integrate manufacturing requirements into new product development and industrialisation, ensuring new products and processes are designed with efficient and scalable production in mind.

• Support the introduction and ramp-up of new production lines, developing operational standards, work instructions and training materials while ensuring employees are prepared for new processes and ways of working.

• Build Lean and Continuous Improvement capabilities across the organisation, coaching employees and leaders and facilitating workshops that enable teams to identify and implement sustainable improvements themselves.

• Measure and sustain improvement initiatives, ensuring projects translate into tangible improvements in productivity, quality, lead time and overall operational efficiency.

**What Drives Success

**You combine strong manufacturing knowledge with the ability to turn improvement opportunities into practical, sustainable change.

You will likely bring:

• At least 5 years of relevant experience within Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or a comparable manufacturing improvement role.

• Proven experience designing, implementing or optimising production lines within a manufacturing environment.

• Strong practical knowledge of Lean manufacturing and Continuous Improvement methodologies, including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, root cause analysis and process standardisation.

• Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects, workshops and transformation initiatives from identification through implementation.

• The ability to influence change across an organisation, working effectively with operators, specialists, engineers, managers and senior leadership.

• Strong coaching and facilitation capabilities, with experience developing Lean and Continuous Improvement capabilities in others.

• A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving combined with a willingness to work hands-on with production teams.

• Strong project management and organisational capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple improvement initiatives simultaneously.

• Experience leading or developing technical employees and creating an engaged, performance-oriented team environment.

**Real Impact

**Imagine a new production line is being introduced to support NOVENCO’s future manufacturing requirements.

Rather than simply installing equipment and adapting processes afterwards, you bring Production, Engineering, Quality and other stakeholders together early. You map the value stream, challenge unnecessary process steps, optimise material and operator flow, establish standardised ways of working and prepare the production team for launch.

Once production begins, you monitor performance, identify bottlenecks and lead targeted improvement activities.

The result is a production line that reaches its performance targets faster, with stronger productivity, quality and operational stability while leaving the organization with the knowledge and capabilities to continue improving it.

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in shaping NOVENCO’s future manufacturing and Operational Excellence strategy.

• The opportunity to design and implement new production systems rather than simply optimise existing processes.

• Direct influence on productivity, quality, lead time and operational performance across our manufacturing organisation.

• Leadership responsibility for a small team of Production Technicians and Engineers.

• Close collaboration across Production, Engineering, Quality and other functions.

• The opportunity to build Lean and Continuous Improvement capabilities across the organisation and create sustainable operational change.

• Competitive salary of 50K - 60K DKK Per month and employee benefits in line with company policy.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege.

**Context

**The CI Project Manager / Operational Excellence Expert is based at NOVENCO Building & Industry’s headquarters and manufacturing facility in Næstved, Denmark, and reports directly to the Plant Manager.

This is an on-site manufacturing role requiring close collaboration with production teams and other functions across the organisation.

The position combines Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, production development, project leadership and people leadership, with responsibility for creating both immediate operational improvements and sustainable long-term capabilities.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Job posting for Student Instructors at Cognitive Science and Linguistics

Spring 2027

We are looking to hire six-seven student instructors from 1 January to 31 may 2027 for the following courses:

BSc in Cognitive Science:

• Philosophy of Cognitive Science (2 hours/week, 13 weeks)

• Methods 2: General Linear Model (4 hours/week, 13 weeks – two instructors)

• Cognitive Neuroscience (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Methods 4: Bayesian Computational Modeling (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Social and Cultural Dynamics (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

MA in Linguistics:

• Computational Linguistics (2 hours/week, 12 weeks)

Programming skills necessary - see course description.

BA in Linguistics:

• Studiume Generale (2 hours/week, 13 weeks) (please notice; course in Danish)

Qualifications

Applicants should have:

• A solid background in the relevant academic areas for the position, including good grades for the course they are applying for, and other related courses.

• Good communication skills, including the ability to work well with course coordinators, the ability to communicate well with students, and the ability to facilitate discussion and collaboration between students.

• The ability to help course coordinators in preparing class activities, and to interpret and implement class plans in a clear and organized way.

• Is enrolled as a student at Aarhus University when teaching.

We recommend that you participate in a basic pedagogical course for student instructors, lasting approx. 12 hours. Participation in the course as an instructor is paid once during your study period.

Terms of employment

In most courses, instructors will be required to teach a total of 26 hours. For each hour taught, instructors will receive 1.5 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 65 paid hours. If the instructor has to teach the same content to two different classes, the preparation time for class two will only be 0.75 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 55,25 paid hours.

The hourly rate of pay is DKK 291,80, including holiday pay.

Application process

When applying, please attach your application letter, CV, and grade transcripts.

You are more than welcome to apply for more than one course, please write your prioritized order for the courses. Each course requires a separate application. You will need to write them in the same document or attach it as extra attachments in the application system.

Each application should include a letter stating:

• Which course you are applying to serve as instructor for.

• A short motivation for your application for that course.

• A short description of relevant knowledge and skills for the role of instructor, specific to the course you are applying for.

Application letters for each course should be no longer than a single A4 page.

The deadline is 9 November, and we hope to get back to you before Christmas.

If you have any questions, please contact Head of Department, Joshua Charles Skewes at afdelingsleder.lics@cc.au.dk.

About Arts

The Faculty of Arts is one of Northern Europe’s most significant faculties for research and higher education in the humanities, theology and education. Within this broad academic scope, the faculty comprises approximately 700 researchers, 200 PhD students, 9,000 Bachelor’s and Master’s degree students, and 1,500 further and continuing education students. We believe that the best ideas arise when different perspectives meet – and that research, teaching and innovation are best developed in dialogue with the surrounding society.

You can find more information here: Faculty of Arts | Aarhus University

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

**Job Description

**Do you have a keen interest in financial markets and sustainability? Do you enjoy developing high‑quality financial analysis with strategic impact? And are you ready to take a key role in advising some of the largest and most complex corporates in Denmark on capital structure, funding strategy and sustainability? This entry-level role offers rapid learning and broad exposure to complex advisory work.

**What You Will Be Doing

**As an Analyst in our Corporate & Sustainability Advisory team, you will work alongside senior colleagues to deliver strategic financial advice to large corporate clients. You will be part of our newly integrated Denmark and Norway team, collaborating across markets to provide tailor-made solutions on capital structure, funding strategy, and sustainability initiatives.

• Conduct high-quality financial statement analysis with strategic importance for clients

• Develop expertise in capital structure, credit ratings, acquisition capacity, and funding strategy while integrating sustainability initiatives to enhance financial outcomes and value creation

• Prepare clear and engaging client presentations and management materials

• Support client engagements, pitches, and analytical projects across markets

• Contribute to improving analytical models and client materials

**About You

**To succeed in this role, you should have:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related field with strong academic record

• Strong analytical capabilities and commercial mindset

• Genuine interest in sustainability and financial markets

• Structured working approach with clear communication skills

• Fluency in Danish and English for cross-country collaboration

• Ability to deliver high-quality results in collaborative environments

Experience from banking, consulting, treasury, or client-facing roles would be beneficial for your success in this position.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a highly skilled advisory team within a leading Nordic financial institution. We provide exposure to complex projects and collaboration across diverse teams. Our supportive learning environment focuses on continuous feedback, and you will be part of a pan-Nordic network of professionals with strong opportunities for development within strategic corporate advisory and sustainable finance.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We believe diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our team, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

For more information, please contact Head of Corporate & Sustainability Advisory DK/NO Anders Johannessen at ajohan@danskebank.dk or Chief Analyst Hanne Brendstrup at habre@danskebank.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

Do you have solid experience leading large-scale IT projects? Are you motivated by delivering innovative IT solutions to complex, society-critical challenges? If so, you may be our next colleague in the role of IT Manager at Netcompany. As a Manager, you will be challenged in a position that requires strong leadership capabilities as well as technical expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Manager, you will be responsible for leading large-scale IT projects from initiation through successful delivery. You will manage project teams, oversee project risks, and ensure high standards of quality, delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction. In addition, you will play a key role in client advisory services, business development activities, and proposal management.

Beyond your leadership responsibilities, you will be expected to contribute with strong technical expertise. You will act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on technical solution design and implementation, helping project teams and clients solve complex challenges.

Alongside your project management responsibilities, you will serve as a mentor to consultants and senior consultants. This long-term mentoring relationship will give you the opportunity to support, guide, and contribute to the professional development of your mentees throughout their careers at Netcompany.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Leading projects and ensuring successful delivery and progress, typically based on agile development methodologies.

• Participating in steering committee meetings with senior representatives from both Netcompany and the client organization.

• Advising the client on project deliverables.

• Coordinating activities across multiple project workstreams, including testing, organizational implementation, and software development.

• Leading proposal teams and conducting development and performance discussions with your mentees.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you have:

• 
Strong technical expertise and relevant experience within the IT industry.

• 
Proven experience leading large and complex IT delivery projects, including projects utilizing agile development methodologies.

• 
Strong commercial awareness combined with the ability to build trust and lead high-performing teams.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

**Overview

**We are seeking an experienced site-based Project Manager and Site Lead to oversee daily project execution in the Project Execution department. The role integrates production, schedule management, commercial controls, and collaboration with NNPR. Reporting to the PMO, you will lead both the Core Team and Site Team to ensure project objectives are met. You will coordinate across functional roles including construction management, planning, controlling, and QA/QC HSE.

**Responsibilities

**

• 
Manage overall project delivery and daily site execution, including staffing, subcontractors, work fronts, and work prioritization.

• 
Lead weekly Core Team and Site Team meetings to ensure realistic work plans, production follow-up, and issue resolution.

• 
Serve as Beritech’s primary operational contact to NNPR, facilitating clear decisions, agreements, meeting minutes, and follow‐up.

• 
Ensure timely documentation of changes, delays, and impacts via Dalux EWN, manage CAN/CO processes, and provide input for time and payment claims.

• 
Own project budget, forecasts, risk registers, and management reporting; track hours, quantities, changes, and invoicing basis with controller and planner.

• 
Coordinate technical releases with the technical project manager and oversee HSE, QA/QC, testing, documentation, and final handover activities.

• 
Identify and escalate obstacles and interface issues promptly to maintain project momentum and align stakeholder expectations.

**Required Education

**Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Marine Engineer or a related field is required.

**Required Experience

**Minimum 7-10 years of proven experience leading large mechanical installations, preferably process piping or pharma projects, with strong site planning, production control, and multidisciplinary coordination. Demonstrated expertise in interpreting contracts, quantity accounting, change management, and documenting schedule and cost impacts is essential. Living close to Køge to commute to site. Danish and english is a requirement.

**Additional Requirements

**Fluent written and verbal Danish and English; experience with Dalux software and systematic reporting tools. Ability to travel daily to the project site in Køge. HSE certification and valid construction safety training are required.

**Skills

**

• 
Site Management

• 
Production Planning

• 
Commercial Control

• 
Change Management

• 
Contract Administration

• 
Team Leadership

As a Consulting Solution Architect for the Data Management domain, you will serve as a trusted advisor throughout consulting engagements — helping clients shape feasible solution options, leading or supporting the design of custom, high‑value solutions, and ensuring strong domain integrity aligned with the broader SimCorp One solution design. You will play a central role in supporting scalable, high‑quality custom implementations and contribute to consistency and excellence across our Consulting organization.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Consulting, Product Management, and Value Streams to ensure our custom solutions remain both feasible and aligned to SimCorp standards. You will also help advance our practices, strengthen our knowledge base, and mentor the next generation of solutioning talent within SimCorp.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As SimCorp embarks on the SimCorp One journey, the Consulting Solution Architect plays a critical role in enabling the Consulting organization to deliver high‑quality, scalable custom solutions. Consulting Solution Architects ensure that custom client requirements are shaped and delivered with strong domain integrity, consistency, and alignment with SimCorp’s delivery methodologies (Compass) and the SimCorp One solution.

You will:

• Influence key architectural decisions in strategic and complex consulting projects

• Strengthen our consulting methodologies and enablement efforts

• Contribute to the evolution of consulting solution best practices and patterns

Our new Consulting Solution Architects bring deep domain experience within the scope of the Data Management Sub-Service Line and the consulting skills needed to act as trusted advisors to internal and external clients.

This is a global position, with potential locations across SimCorp offices worldwide. International travel may be required based on client needs. The role reports to the Global Practice Lead.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Global Practice Ownership

**

• Own the Global consulting practice within your domain. This includes ownership of the global consulting artifacts for your domain.

• Contribute with structured feedback into standards evolution.

• Shape and define our consulting practice within your domain.

• Support the enablement of consultants to deliver custom client solutions with high quality, consistency, and aligned with the SimCorp One solution.

**Scoping & Advisory

**

• Lead or support domain‑specific consulting scoping during sales and early project phases for complex and strategic consulting engagements

• Act as the key advisor for solution options and custom feasibility

• Collaborate with Sales, Engagement Leads, Product Management, and Value Streams

• Define and validate custom architecture and design in complex and strategic client projects

• Ensure custom build quality and provide ongoing design assurance

• Resolve domain-specific challenges in collaboration with consulting, value streams, and product teams

**Knowledge Enablement

**

• Document and disseminate domain knowledge and best practices

• Support onboarding and capability building within Consulting

• Collaborate on cross‑functional learning initiatives

**Collaboration & Influence

**

• Work closely with Product Management, Value Streams, and project teams

• Represent your domain in discussions on solution direction and domain challenges

• Interface with clients, including senior stakeholders, on custom solution matters

**Mentoring & Community Leadership

**

• Coach consultants and aspiring architects

• Help grow solutioning maturity within Consulting

• Influence cross‑domain architecture discussions and knowledge sharing

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to excel at several of the following skills and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.

• Relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a relevant Business degree

• At least 7+ years of proven experience designing and implementing SimCorp Dimension solutions

• Deep business knowledge within the Data Management domain. Experience with the SimCorp Data Management Core solution and the SimCorp Data Management Service is a plus.

• Understanding of our clients’ general business processes and operating model

• International experience and global mindset

• Have been involved in several SimCorp Dimension implementations from the early stages of the project

• Ability to build relationships, drive discussions and impact stakeholders when required

• Engagement in partnering with various parts of the SimCorp organization

• Proactiveness, creativeness and commercial mindedness with a global perspective

• Proficiency in English

**Benefits

**SimCorp offers several benefits that might play a significant factor in considering whether to accept a job offer. Since SimCorp operates in 30+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

**NEXT STEPS

The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.

The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company’s value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.

The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer – in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond – and what methods are needed to get there.

You are hired to answer that. You will be the company’s dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.

Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

• Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby

• Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read

• Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not

• Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors

• Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.

What you will actually do

• Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data

• Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions

• Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualisation, presentation of findings

• Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality

• Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in

• Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say “I built that”

• A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control

• Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training

• Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification

• Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking

• Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

• Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count

• PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this

• Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA

• A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field

Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.

Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.

What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company’s first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.

What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company’s hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.

Interested, or want to know more?

Black Swans Exist is running this search exclusively. We will tell you who the company is at first conversation, and we will tell you the parts that are not in this document.

If it is not right for you but you know who it is right for, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

The Department of Biomedicine at the Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Assistant Professor in the field of experimental virology as per 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a fixed-term full-time position for 18 months.

The Department of Biomedicine prioritises diversity and a good work environment, as this is a prerequisite for groundbreaking research. In a diverse and international research environment, dedicated employees are looking to generate new knowledge within biomedical research areas such as infection and inflammation, membranes, neuroscience and personalised medicine. The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. Academic staff contribute to the teaching. English is the preferred language in the laboratory, at meetings and at seminars. The department employs approx. 500 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory-, core- and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration with business and industry, and numerous researchers from the department have established companies to develop new medicinal treatments founded in professional scientific basic research. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities
As Assistant Professor in Experimental Virology, your primary tasks will be research and research-based teaching. You will teach and supervise students at Bachelor’s and Master’s level, and you will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. In your daily work, you will work closely with both Danish and international colleagues. The position of Assistant Professor is a career development position in which you will receive supervision and pedagogical upgrading.

Your main tasks will consist of:

 * Independent research of high international quality on virus-host interactions, innate immune sensing and inflammasome signalling during RNA-virus infection, including publication of the results.

 * Establishment and characterisation of relevant cellular and cancer-associated experimental models to study how innate sensing pathways influence viral replication, cell death and oncolytic-virus responses.

 * Contribution to related collaborative projects in oncolytic virotherapy and antiviral innate immunity, including projects involving complementary RNA- and DNA-virus systems.

 * Teaching, guidance and examination of Bachelor’s and Master’s degree students, contribution to day-to-day supervision of junior researchers, and some degree of contribution towards attracting external research funding.

You will report to the the Head of Department, Professor Thomas G. Jensen.

Your competences
You have a PhD in virology, immunology, biochemistry, molecular medicine or a closely related field and independent research qualifications at a high international level. Your research profile should combine experimental virology with immunology and should demonstrate substantial hands-on experience studying host responses to virus infection.

For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on documented experience with:

 * Multiple RNA-virus systems and comparative virus-host studies; experience with VSV or another experimentally tractable negative-strand RNA virus is highly relevant.

 * Mechanisms connecting viral infection with inflammatory signalling, type-I interferon responses, cell death, cellular metabolism, mitochondrial function and/or reactive oxygen species.

 * Mammalian cell culture and quantitative virology approaches, supported by relevant molecular and cellular methods such as infection assays, immunoblotting, RT-qPCR, flow cytometry and microscopy.

 * Scientific publication in peer-reviewed international journals, including evidence of substantial intellectual contribution such as first- or co-first authorship.

 * Research collaboration in an international environment and supervision or mentoring of university students or junior researchers.

Experience with oncolytic virotherapy, cancer-relevant infection models, or translation of fundamental virus-host biology towards therapeutic virology will be considered an advantage. You are a clear communicator and have some experience of supervision and teaching at Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree level. Completed pedagogical training and experience with external research collaborations will be viewed positively.

As a person, you have good interpersonal skills, are inclusive and team-oriented, and are able to contribute to a good work environment. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish, and Aarhus University arranges Danish teaching.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Assistant Professor position, you must meet the academic criteria applicable at Aarhus University.

Shortlisting will be used.

To be considered for the position, applicants must meet the formal requirements for academic appointments at Aarhus University and submit all required application materials by the deadline. Applications that are substantially incomplete will not proceed to further assessment.
